title: Latent Policy Barrier: Learning Robust Visuomotor Policies by Staying In-Distribution

layout.note: Two large organic blobs side by side, pink on the left and blue on the right, each with a bold title above, a wavy peach expert band running from lower left to a star at upper right, and one shared two-row legend underneath.

lesson: Contrast an old and a new correction strategy on one identical toy task: same start, goal and expert band in two tinted panels, with the baseline's failures marked by verdict words and the new method shown as one detect-and-steer hop (coloured dot, arrow, dot).
